expressions:
Create a polished production CHARACTER EXPRESSION DESIGN SHEET for TAEGO, the unique adult white tiger guardian of Hangul Sori, based on the attached USER-APPROVED design. This is a reference-guided continuation of that exact character, not a new tiger.

Authority: reference 1 bottom three rendered heads defines the approved face, expressive shape language and welcoming wise personality; reference 2 defines the approved adult anatomy, fur and chest. Do not reproduce the construction sketches. Keep the same long feline nasal bridge, separate muzzle pads, pink-brown nose, white whiskers, angular cheek tufts, small tiger ears, blue-grey layered irises with visible round pupils, warm ivory-white fur and charcoal stripes. No bear, cub, plush toy, photoreal stock tiger, oversized eyes, new brows, mane, horns or human smile. Use the exact teal and gold THREE-curl emblem on anatomical LEFT chest (viewer right on frontal). No redesign of markings or emblem.

Output ONE landscape sheet on a TRUE TRANSPARENT background, 4 columns x 2 rows, eight clearly separated head-and-upper-chest portraits with generous transparent gaps and no cropped ears/whiskers. Same lens, same scale, same neutral warm studio lighting and material across all eight. Premium sculpted animated-feature illustration matching the reference, fine directional fur with clean clump structure, natural volume. Add only small legible labels T-E01 ... T-E08 below each portrait; no panels, no scenery, no sketches.

Critically the expressions must look observably DIFFERENT even with labels hidden. Couple eyes, eyelids, ears, muzzle and neck; do not recycle one neutral head:
T-E01 Calm companion / welcome: almost frontal, makes gentle direct eye contact, open receptive eyelids, relaxed closed mouth, ears quietly forward.
T-E02 Attentive listening: head and upper neck turn together slightly toward a speaker just left of camera at eye level, small inquisitive tilt, focused pupils, one ear tracking that same speaker; closed soft muzzle. No looking down.
T-E03 Warm approval: direct eye contact, visibly lifted relaxed cheeks, softly narrowed pleased eyes, a small natural open feline jaw as in the approved I KNOW YOU face, no teeth presentation or human grin.
T-E04 Curiosity: neck a little taller, ears perked, eyelids more open without changing eyeball size; gaze anchored toward a clue just right of camera.
T-E05 Concern for friend: brow-fur and inner eyelids soften upward, ears move slightly outward, muzzle settles, head comes gently toward the viewer at eye height; protective empathy rather than fear or threatening stare.
T-E06 Painful memory: visibly lowered upper lids and quiet gaze down-left, ear tension released, slightly lowered entire neck, mouth softly closed; grief not aggression or injury.
T-E07 Protective resolve: head level, neck settled in strong shoulders, clear steady forward gaze, outer eyelids firm but inner eyes warm, ears attentive not flattened, mouth closed. He is protecting the viewer, not hunting them.
T-E08 Reunion relief: shoulders visibly release, gentle head tilt toward viewer, pleased soft half-open eyes with pupils visible, relaxed cheek pads and mouth; emotional warmth, not the same as T-E01.

The approved new face is essential. Maintain an ADULT guardian's dignity with clear stylized acting. No glow that erases pupils, no floating pupils or divergent gaze, no wet tears, no aggressive fangs. Output true RGBA transparency including between all portraits.
poses:
Create a production FULL-BODY ACTING DESIGN SHEET for TAEGO, the exact adult white tiger guardian in the two approved reference sheets. Reference 1 is the face authority (use the bottom rendered heads, not pencil sketches); reference 2 is the approved long adult body authority. Continue this exact Hangul Sori character, retaining mature feline anatomy, head proportions, charcoal stripe arrangement, ivory-white directional fur, layered blue-grey irises with visible pupils, pink-brown nose and long white whiskers. The small teal/gold THREE-curl emblem remains on anatomical LEFT chest only. Do not reset to a generic tiger or enlarge the cheeks into a bear.

ONE landscape sheet, 3 columns x 2 rows, six SEPARATE full-body figures at a consistent scale, each on true transparent background with broad empty gaps. Whole ears, all four limbs and entire long ringed tail within each cell. No environment, no decorative frame, no construction drawings, no halo or cloud. Label only T-P01 ... T-P06 in small tasteful teal text. Maintain adult elongated rib cage, tucked waist, defined hips, shoulders and long tiger legs; broad weight-bearing paws, soft clean paw contacts. High-end sculpted animation-film illustration as in approved sheet, detailed short fur, longer cheek/chest tufts without a mane. Warm neutral consistent studio illumination.

Show clearly different meaningful acting:
T-P01 seated companion: mature upright sitting, slightly three-quarter body, chest spacious, hindquarters grounded, both forepaws firmly below shoulders; head frontal, kind direct eye contact. Calm open ears, closed mouth. Long tail rests gently to one side.
T-P02 lower-head listen: a supported low feline crouch, forelegs flex and chest lowers WITH head; long spine flows naturally into neck, NO downward crane from a rigid standing body. Head remains level to an imagined seated friend just left of camera, eyes and ears attend that same point. Warm listening face, no hunting crouch.
T-P03 inspect clue: standing in side/three-quarter view, torso angled toward a clue near the paws. One small deliberate forward step, whole shoulders and neck align to the clue; curious face, relaxed tail, no crossed eyes or sharply broken neck.
T-P04 guide path: easy walking step in side view, head turns only modestly toward the viewer, softly reassuring eye contact, clear space between four legs, paws and weight anatomically coherent. Not a charging predator.
T-P05 quiet protection: broad adult body stands laterally across a path, stable four-paw base and even level shoulders; head turned toward the viewer in calm resolve, friendly visible eyes, ears alert but not pinned, closed jaw; he shelters a friend behind him, without another character drawn.
T-P06 chin on paws rest: elongated reclining adult tiger, chin relaxed on extended forepaws, hindquarters naturally folded to side, long ringed tail visible, softly half-open eyes looking directly toward viewer, tender relaxed connection rather than lifeless sleep.

No baby/cub proportions, no plush or bear torso, no giant head or circular body, no exposed claws, no snarling/fangs, no fixed blank stare. Grounded poses and connected eye-neck-body acting are essential. True RGBA background, no opaque floor.
